# FR-DP-XXX-NNN — <System behavior>

## Requirement statement
The system shall <single, testable externally observable behavior>.

## Preconditions and trigger
List relevant initial state, initiator, action and required permissions.

## Main behavior
Describe business behavior; do not invent HTTP methods, DTOs, schema, framework patterns or implementation details.

## Validation, business rules and authorization
State constraints and applicable BR/NFR IDs, tenant/project visibility and role/policy boundaries.

## Failure and edge cases
Describe invalid state, conflicting operations, concurrency, retry or expiration where relevant.

## Verification criteria
List falsifiable expected outcomes, including negative and authorization scenarios when applicable.

## Open questions
Record missing policy decisions and their impact. Do not make critical assumptions into requirements.
